name: Wolf Shaman
summary: A shaman with this totem calls upon the clever wolf, capable of roaming alone yet wise enough to run with a pack when facing dangers too great for one alone.

features.name: Nature Bond
features.summary: A wolf shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a wolf. If choosing a domain, the wolf shaman must choose from the Animal, Community, Liberation, and Travel domains.

features.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
features.summary: A wolf shaman can use wild empathy with canines as a full-round action with a +4 bonus.

features.name: Totem Transformation (Su)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a wolf shaman may adopt an aspect of the wolf while retaining her normal form. This ability functions as the bear shaman ability, but the druid may select from the following bonuses: movement (+20 enhancement bonus to land speed), senses (low-light vision, scent, +4 racial bonus to Survival when tracking by scent), or natural weapons (bite [1d4 plus trip] for a Medium druid, +2 CMB to trip). While using totem transformation, the wolf shaman may speak normally and can cast speak with animals (canines only) at will.

resourceActions.label: Activate Totem Transformation

modes.label: Senses
modes.summary: Gain low-light vision, scent, and +4 Survival when tracking by scent. +4 racial bonus on Survival checks when tracking by scent.

activeEffects.label: Wolf senses
activeEffects.description: Gain low-light vision, scent, and +4 Survival when tracking by scent.

activeEffects.label: Tracking by scent
activeEffects.description: +4 racial bonus on Survival checks when tracking by scent.

modes.label: Natural weapons
modes.summary: Gain a bite (1d4 plus trip) and +2 CMB to trip.

activeEffects.label: Wolf bite
activeEffects.description: Gain a bite (1d4 plus trip) and +2 CMB to trip.

resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 minute of Totem Transformation and apply the selected aspect for 10 rounds.

resourceActions.label: Speak with canines

confirmations.label: The target is one of the permitted canines

resourceActions.summary: At-will speak with animals, restricted to canines.

features.name: Totemic Summons (Su)
features.summary: At 5th level, a wolf shaman may cast summon nature’s ally as a standard action when summoning canines, and these summoned creatures gain temporary hit points equal to her druid level. This ability otherwise functions as the bear shaman ability.

resourceActions.label: Resolve Totemic Summons

modes.label: Young (spell level -1)
modes.summary: Apply the young template and reduce the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Normal
modes.summary: Use the normal summon spell level.

modes.label: Advanced (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the advanced template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Giant (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the giant template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Advanced + giant (spell level +2)
modes.summary: Apply both templates and increase the required summon spell level by 2.

activeEffect.name: Wolf Shaman Totemic Summons
activeEffect.description: Summoned canines gain temporary hit points equal to your druid level; track their summon duration separately.

resourceActions.summary: Cast summon nature's ally as a standard action for canines; summoned creatures gain temporary hit points equal to druid level.

features.name: Wild Shape (Su)
features.summary: At 6th level, a wolf shaman’s wild shape ability functions at her druid level – 2. If she takes on the form of a canine, she instead uses her druid level + 2. This ability replaces wild shape.

resourceActions.label: Assume Shaman Wild Shape

activeEffects.label: Favored wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level +2.

activeEffects.label: Adjusted wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level -2.

resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 wild shape use and track the correct effective druid level for the selected form.

progressionProfiles.label: Wild Shape Effective Level
progressionProfiles.summary: Effective druid levels used by normal and totem-favored wild shape forms.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, a wolf shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: Greater Trip, Improved Trip, Mobility, Skill Focus (Stealth), or Spring Attack. She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats. This ability replaces venom immunity.

mechanicalNotes: Nature Bond restrictions, Wild Empathy, daily transformation minutes, aspect modes, at-will animal speech, template-aware summons, effective wild-shape levels, and all bonus-feat slots are automated.
